en.headline: Provisional voter registers released with 64,900 new geographical electors
en.dek: The Registration and Electoral Office published the 2026 provisional registers and omissions lists; the public has until 25 August to check particulars or lodge claims.
body: The Registration and Electoral Office released the 2026 provisional registers of electors and voters together with the related omissions lists on Saturday.

For geographical constituencies, the provisional register contains about 4,120,100 electors. This includes roughly 64,900 new registrations and 127,800 updates to personal particulars. About 24,900 records were removed because of death and a further 57,700 were placed on the omissions list after inquiries.

Functional constituencies show about 190,700 registered electors, while Election Committee subsectors list about 9,300 voters. The figures incorporate new registrations, changes of constituency or subsector, and removals arising from death or unresolved inquiries.

An REO spokesman said letters and messages had already been sent to relevant electors and voters. Those on the omissions lists will receive beige reminding letters and must confirm eligibility by 25 August or risk losing their voting rights. Claims or objections may also be lodged by the same deadline. Final registers will be published on 25 September.

zh.headline: 2026年臨時選民登記冊公布 地方選區新增約6.49萬人
zh.dek: 選舉事務處今日公布臨時選民登記冊及遭剔除者名單，市民可於8月25日前核對資料或提出申索及反對。
body: 選舉事務處今日公布2026年地方選區、功能界別及選舉委員會界別分組的臨時選民／投票人登記冊，以及相關遭剔除者名單。
地方選區臨時登記冊約有412.01萬名選民，當中包括約6.49萬名新登記人士及約12.78萬宗更改資料申請。另有約2.49萬名因去世而被剔除，以及約5.77萬名經查詢後列入遭剔除者名單。
功能界別約有19.07萬名選民，選舉委員會界別分組則約有9,300名投票人，數字已計及新登記、轉界及因去世或查詢而剔除的個案。
選舉事務處發言人表示，已向有關選民／投票人發出信件及訊息。遭剔除者名單上的人士會收到米色提示信，須於8月25日前確認資格，否則可能喪失投票權。市民亦可於同日前就登記事宜提出申索或反對。正式登記冊將於9月25日公布。
